# @msameim181/iran-map-react

> React SVG map of Iran with provinces, counties, capitals, Persian and English names, selection, and choropleth colors.

This is the React package in a family with @msameim181/iran-map-core (framework-free data and logic) and @msameim181/iran-map-vue (Vue components). Read the README for props and the CHANGELOG for migration behavior.

Install with `npm install @msameim181/iran-map-react` from npmjs.com; no token is needed. Requires React and react-dom 16.14+ and Node.js 18+. Import `@msameim181/iran-map-react/styles.css` explicitly once in your app.

The root entry binds provinces and province capitals. `/full` binds every catalog; `/lite` binds every catalog at lite detail. Standard and mini levels use core presets through `catalogs` or `createIranMap`. `/score-bands` contains the standalone legend/editor without map data. Keep data and array props referentially stable. Server rendering is supported; under React < 18, pass a stable `tooltipId` for hydration.

نقشه ایران برای React با استان، شهرستان، مراکز استان و نام‌های فارسی برای ساخت نقشه تعاملی.

- [CHANGELOG](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Msameim181/iran-map-react/main/CHANGELOG.md): Release history and behavior changes.
- [Main props](https://github.com/Msameim181/iran-map-react/blob/main/README.md#main-props): IranMap prop table.
- [IranMapProps and createIranMap](https://github.com/Msameim181/iran-map-react/blob/main/src/components/IranMap.tsx): React-specific props and catalog binding.
- [Root API](https://github.com/Msameim181/iran-map-react/blob/main/src/index.ts): Lean exports and public types.
- [Full API](https://github.com/Msameim181/iran-map-react/blob/main/src/full.ts): Every catalog and map exports.
- [Lite API](https://github.com/Msameim181/iran-map-react/blob/main/src/lite.ts): Lite catalogs and map exports.
- [ScoreBands API](https://github.com/Msameim181/iran-map-react/blob/main/src/score-bands.ts): Catalog-free legend/editor exports.
- [ScoreBands props](https://github.com/Msameim181/iran-map-react/blob/main/README.md#standalone-score-band-legend-and-editor): Legend and editor usage.
